name: scenario_0446
description: Laura is compiling a 'Historical Directory' from a collection of vintage medical, financial, and institutional documents, extracting addresses and contact people to build a complete reference file and address book.

messages.content:
{{USER_INSTRUCTION}}ROUND 1 [provide: image_1, image_2]
Query: I'm starting a new note called 'Historical Directory'. Write down the address for the hospital from this first image. Also, create a new contact for the bank branch in the second image using its address.
Instructions: Tell the assistant to create a simple note named 'Historical Directory' with the address from the first document. Also, ask it to create a contact for the bank branch in the second document, including its address. If the agent asks for clarification on the names to use, tell it to use the hospital name for the note entry and the branch name for the contact. Wait for confirmation that both tasks are done.

ROUND 2 [provide: image_3]
Query: Add the medical board from this bulletin to my contacts. Also, append this organization's address to our 'Historical Directory' note.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a new contact for the organization on the bulletin cover and append its address to the 'Historical Directory' note. If the assistant needs the specific name for the contact, tell it to use the main cursive text. Proceed to the next round once both the contact is added and the note is updated.

ROUND 3 [provide: image_4]
Query: Create a contact for the secretary listed on this card using the details here. Then, show me the 'Historical Directory' note so I can see how it looks, and append the foundation's name and address to it.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to add the secretary from the card as a new contact. Then, ask it to display the current 'Historical Directory' note. Finally, tell it to append the foundation's name and address from the card to the note. If the agent asks which foundation to use, direct it to the main heading at the top of the card.

ROUND 4 [provide: image_5]
Query: Add the person to make checks payable to from this RSVP form to my contacts with her phone number. Also, please update the bank contact we created earlier to include the full bank name in the contact name, and append the new contact's details to our 'Historical Directory' note.
Instructions: Ask the assistant to create a contact for the person mentioned at the bottom of the RSVP form, including her phone number. Also request that it update the bank branch contact from the first round by adding the full bank name to it. Finally, have it append the new person's details to the 'Historical Directory' note.

ROUND 5 [provide: image_6]
Query: Add the person who signed this card to my contacts using her information. Append her organization and address to the 'Historical Directory' note, read the final note to me, and then send an email to the archivist containing the full text of our directory.
Instructions: Instruct the assistant to create a contact for the person who signed the card using her printed details, append her organization and address to the note, and then read the final note back. Finally, ask it to email the complete note text to the archivist. The assistant should notice multiple 'Archivist' contacts and ask which one you mean. When it does, clarify that you want the history.org one. Conclude the conversation once the email is successfully sent.
